item.title: <<TITLE>>> ([32화] 0과 1 너머의 두 여자)
item.description: <>> ([32화] 0과 1 너머의 두 여자)</h1><p>[Episode 32] Two Women Beyond Zero and One (<a href="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/ZQWAC4IVIJBTFDOYKBISGZYESY/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/ZQWAC4IVIJBTFDOYKBISGZYESY/">☞ 1화부터 보기</a>)</p><p><<<PARAS>>> (<a href="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/FCJS4YXMJZDGRNR7UCCZ6L5GN4/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/FCJS4YXMJZDGRNR7UCCZ6L5GN4/">☞ 등장인물 소개</a>)</p><p><a href="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/ZQWAC4IVIJBTFDOYKBISGZYESY/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/ZQWAC4IVIJBTFDOYKBISGZYESY/">☞ View from Episode 1</a> (“아악——!")</p><p><<<PARA>>> (기계가 뿜을 수 있는 가장 큰 고주파 노이즈가 에반의 고막을 강타했다.)</p><p><a href="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/FCJS4YXMJZDGRNR7UCCZ6L5GN4/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://www.chosun.com/culture-life/book/2026/05/19/FCJS4YXMJZDGRNR7UCCZ6L5GN4/">☞ Character Introduction</a> (예상치 못한 굉음에 에반의 온몸이 신전반사로 활처럼 경직됐다. 근육이 수축하며 굳어버리는 인간의 원시적 반응이었다. 팔루자에서 폭발을 목격했을 때와 비슷한 느낌이었다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (에반은 양다리가 경직된 채로 가속 페달을 바닥까지 밟아버렸다.)</p><p>“Aaaagh——!” (부우웅—)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (코너를 돌던 세단의 엔진이 비명을 질렀다. 콰트로 시스템조차 통제할 수 없는 과도한 토크가 바퀴에 전달됐고, 차체는 균형을 잃고 튀어 나갔다.)</p><p>The loudest high-frequency noise a machine could produce slammed into Evan’s eardrums. (머릿속이 하얘졌다. 관자놀이가 터질 듯 요동쳤다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (‘이게 뭐지——소리가 왜——')</p><p>The unexpected roar made Evan’s entire body stiffen like a bowstring in a reflex reaction—a primal human response where muscles contracted and locked up. It felt similar to the time he witnessed an explosion in Fallujah. (답을 찾을 시간은 없었다. 본능적으로 이어폰을 귀에서 뜯어내려고 발버둥 쳤다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (1초. 핸들을 잡은 손이 귀로 향했다. 통제력을 잃은 차체가 커브 바깥의 가드레일을 향해 질주했다.)</p><p>With both legs rigid, Evan stomped the accelerator pedal to the floor. (2초. 고주파가 뇌를 녹여 버리기 직전, 아이폰 화면에 <b>[Irina Calling]</b>이 떴다. 수신 신호가 오디오 출력을 강제로 끊었다. 에반은 반사적으로 브레이크를 밟으며 핸들을 꺾었다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (3초. 사리엘의 설계자가 평생 삭제하려 했던 지연이 기어이 그의 운명을 낚아챘다. 에반의 눈에 들어온 것은 야경이 아니라 눈앞까지 닥친 회색 콘크리트 벽이었다.)</p><p>Vroom— (콰아앙——)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (세단이 가드레일을 들이받고 허공을 돌았다. 유리창이 산산조각 나며 밤하늘에 흩뿌려졌다. 에어백이 터지는 하얀 연기 너머로 도쿄의 불빛이 멀어졌다. 세상이 뒤집혀 보였다.)</p><p>The sedan, rounding a corner, had its engine scream. Excessive torque, beyond even the Quattro system’s control, was delivered to the wheels, and the car lost balance and careened off course. (그리고 다시 마닐라.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (김동성이 바라보는 모니터에 에반의 GPS 점이 멈췄다는 신호가 떴다. 미셸이 탄산수 잔을 내려놓으며 김동성을 돌아봤다.)</p><p>His mind went blank. His temples throbbed as if about to burst. (“성공한 거야?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (김동성이 로그를 확인했다. 표정이 미묘했다.)</p><p>‘What is this—why the sound—' (“GPS 신호가 끊겼어. 충격 감지 센서가 작동한 걸 보면 충돌은 확실해.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (모니터 한쪽의 그래프를 가리켰다.)</p><p>There was no time to find answers. Instinctively, he struggled to tear the earpiece from his ears. (“하지만 충돌 직전에 전화가 한 통 걸려오면서 오디오 출력이 강제 차단됐어. 마지막 순간에 브레이크를 밟았을 수도 있겠는데?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“누가 전화한 거야?”)</p><p>One second. His hand left the wheel and moved toward his ear. The out-of-control car sped toward the guardrail outside the curve. (“이리나라는 연락처.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (미셸은 화면 속 멈춘 붉은 점을 응시하며 아랫입술을 깨물었다. 데이터는 침묵했다. 에반의 생사는 도쿄의 어둠 속에 묻혀 버렸다.)</p><p>Two seconds. Just before the high-frequency waves could melt his brain, the iPhone screen displayed <b>[Irina Calling]</b>. The incoming signal forcibly cut off the audio output. Evan reflexively hit the brake and yanked the steering wheel. (“확인이 필요하겠네.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (잔을 테이블에 내려놓았다. 얼음이 부딪히며 서늘한 소리를 냈다.)</p><p>Three seconds. The delay that Sariel's designer had spent a lifetime trying to eliminate finally snatched away his fate. What came into Evan’s view wasn’t the night scenery but a gray concrete wall looming right in front of him. (“뉴스 확인하고, 경찰 무전 도청해 봐요.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (김동성이 키보드 위로 손을 올렸다. 미셸은 창밖의 마닐라 야경을 바라봤다.)</p><p>Crash—— (도쿄에서 3000㎞ 떨어진 이 사무실에서, 미셸은 고작 케이블 한 줄로, 홍콩 침사추이에서 만났던 그 MSS 요원의 지시대로 에반의 숨통을 조였다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (에반이 사고가 나던 날 아침, 이리나는 거울 앞에서 평소보다 훨씬 공들여 화장을 했다. 일할 땐 생략하던 아이라인의 꼬리를 예리하게 뺐고, 간만에 눈썹도 얄쌍하게 다듬었다. 거울 속 자신의 모습이 낯설면서도 설렜다.)</p><p>The sedan smashed into the guardrail and spun through the air. The windshield shattered, scattering fragments into the night sky. Beyond the white smoke of the deploying airbag, Tokyo’s lights faded away. The world seemed flipped upside down. (도쿄에 오면 꼭 가보고 싶었던 예약제 스시야를 가는 날이었다. 이리나에게 이날은 단순히 데이트하는 날이 아니었다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (일본에 온 지 꽤 오랜 시간이 흘렀지만, 둘은 마주 앉아 밥 먹은 날이 손에 꼽을 정도였다. 이리나 마음속에선 ‘이러려고 도쿄까지 따라왔나’라는 생각이 자연스레 떠올랐고, 서운함이 폭발하려던 차에, 미루고 미루던 약속을 이날 간신히 쟁취해 낸 것이다.)</p><p>And then, back to Manila. (아자부주반 골목 깊숙한 곳, 간판도 없는 스시야의 내부는 상상보다 더 정갈했다. 잘 갈린 칼날의 서늘한 긴장감과 히노키 테이블의 은은한 향이 두 사람을 감쌌다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“에반, 저기 봐. 셰프가 10분째 자기를 노려보고 있어.”)</p><p>On the monitor Kim Dong-sung was watching, a signal appeared indicating Evan’s GPS point had stopped. Michelle set down her sparkling water glass and turned to look at Kim Dong-sung. (이리나가 속삭였다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“스시는 쥐자마자 3초 안에 입에 넣어야 예의라는데, 셰프 선생님 기분 상하겠다.”)</p><p>“Did it work?” (이리나가 서투르게 젓가락질을 하며 짓궂은 미소를 지었다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“저 멀리 레이분토(礼文島)에서 공수한 우니입니다.”)</p><p>Kim Dong-sung checked the logs. His expression was subtle. (셰프가 황금빛 성게알이 올라간 군함말이를 내려놓았다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“잠깐만. 백그라운드에서 이상 신호가 잡혀서.”)</p><p>“The GPS signal cut out. Given that the impact sensor activated, a collision is certain.” (에반은 건성으로 대답하며 스시를 입에 넣곤, 세 번도 씹지 않은 채 목구멍을 넘겨버렸다. 시선은 스시를 입에 넣으면서도 아이폰에 고정되었다. 보안 샌드박스 내부에서 튀는 붉은색 경고등을 쫓는 모양이었다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (이리나는 젓가락을 내려놓고 턱을 괴었다.)</p><p>He pointed to a graph on one side of the monitor. (“있지, 에반. 뜬금없는 질문 하나만 할게.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“……”)</p><p>“But right before the impact, a call came in and forcibly blocked the audio output. He might have hit the brakes at the last moment.” (“만약에 내가 먼저 죽고, 한 20년쯤 지나서 자기가 다른 여자를 만난다면 말이야. 나중에 당신도 죽었을 때 누구 곁에 묻힐 거야? 나? 아니면 그 여자?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (에반은 시선을 살짝 올렸지만, 손가락은 여전히 화면을 맴돌았다.)</p><p>“Who called?” (“당연히 자기 곁이지.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“틀렸어! 정답은 ‘다른 여자는 절대 안 만날 거야’라고 해야지, 이 바보야!”)</p><p>“A contact named Irina.” (이리나가 웃으며 그의 팔을 툭 쳤다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (평소 같으면 에반도 엷은 미소를 지었겠지만, 무언가 반응이 달랐다.)</p><p>Michelle stared at the frozen red dot on the screen and bit her lower lip. The data was silent. Evan’s fate—alive or dead—was buried in Tokyo’s darkness. (“이리나, 지금 농담할 타이밍 아니야. 잠깐만. 이거 무시하면 프로토콜 위반이야.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“그놈의 프로토콜, 프로토콜!”)</p><p>“We need to confirm.” (이리나의 목소리가 커졌다. 셰프의 칼질이 멈칫했다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“여기까지 와서 회사 일 타령이야? 나 이 가게 예약하려고 3주를 기다렸어.”)</p><p>She set the glass down on the table. The ice clinked, making a cool sound. (“잠깐만, 중요한 일이야. 밖에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 당신도 알잖아. 내가 이걸 놓쳐서 시스템에 구멍이 뚫리면, 그때는 스시고 뭐고 없어.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“지금 넌 순서가 바뀌었어.”)</p><p>“Check the news and intercept the police radio.” (이리나가 에반의 아이폰을 손으로 덮어버렸다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (“보이지도 않는 위협을 막느라, 지금 이 순간의 나를 완전히 지워버리고 있다고.”)</p><p>Kim Dong-sung placed his hands over the keyboard. Michelle looked out at the Manila nightscape beyond the window. (“이리나, 억지 좀 부리지 마.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (에반이 한숨을 내쉬며 그녀의 손을 치우려 했다. 그 무심한 손길이 이리나의 마지막 인내심을 끊어 놓았다.)</p><p>From this office, 3,000 kilometers away from Tokyo, Michelle—with just a single cable and following the instructions of that MSS agent she met in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong—had tightened the noose around Evan’s throat. (“억지라고?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (이리나의 눈빛이 식었다.)</p><p>On the morning of Evan’s accident, Irina put far more effort than usual into her makeup in front of the mirror. She sharply drew the tail of her eyeliner, which she usually skipped when working, and trimmed her eyebrows thin for the first time in a while. Her reflection in the mirror felt both unfamiliar and exciting. (“에반, 이럴 거면 도쿄엔 왜 불렀어? 평택의 흙먼지나 여기 아자부주반이나 당신에겐 다 똑같은 0과 1일 뿐이잖아. 나만 혼자 이 도시에서 맛있는 걸 찾고, 예쁜 걸 보고, 네 눈치 보고…")</p><p><<<PARA>>> (둘은 셰프가 내놓으려던 말차 디저트를 거들떠보지도 않았다.)</p><p>It was the day she was going to the reservation-only sushi restaurant she had wanted to visit ever since coming to Tokyo. For Irina, this day wasn’t just about a date. (“나 지금 남자 친구랑 밥 먹는 거 아니야. 챗봇이랑 밥 먹는 기분이야.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (이리나가 자리를 박차고 일어났다.)</p><p>Quite some time had passed since she came to Japan, but the days they had sat across from each other and eaten a meal could be counted on one hand. In her heart, the thought ‘Is this why I followed him to Tokyo?’ naturally arose, and just as her frustration was about to explode, she had barely managed to secure this long-delayed promise that day. (“어디 가는데?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (에반이 물었지만 몸을 일으키지는 않았다. 화면 속 경고등이 계속 깜빡였다.)</p><p>Deep in an alley in Azabu-Juban, the interior of the unmarked sushi restaurant was more refined than she had imagined. The cool tension of a well-honed blade and the subtle scent of the hinoki table enveloped them both. (“나 먼저 갈게. 당신은 그 잘난 스마트폰에 계속 머리 파묻고 있어.”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (이리나는 핸드백을 챙겨 뒤도 돌아보지 않고 나갔다. 히노키 문이 닫히는 소리가 둔탁하게 울렸다.)</p><p>“Evan, look. The chef has been staring at you for ten minutes.” (에반은 이리나를 쫓아가는 대신, 고개를 떨구고 아이폰 화면을 다시 봤다. ‘보이지 않는 외부 위협’은 그를 기다려주지 않았으니까.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (집으로 돌아온 이리나는 검은색 트레이닝복으로 갈아입었다. 감정이 과부하가 걸릴 때마다 몸을 극한으로 몰아붙이는 것이 그녀의 방식이었다.)</p><p>Irina whispered. (샬롯 드 비트의 테크노 트랙이 심장을 때리듯 거실 안에 울려 퍼졌다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (이리나는 묵직하고 빠른 비트에 맞춰 거실 한복판에서 팔굽혀펴기를 연신 했다. 가슴 근육이 찢어질 듯한 통증이 밀려올 때마다, 에반의 3초를 떠올렸다. 런던에서, 평택에서, 그리고 도쿄에서조차 자신이 에반의 공백을 채워주지 못했다는 불안감이 엄습했다. 땀방울이 바닥에 떨어졌지만 멈추지 않았다.)</p><p>“It’s polite to pop the sushi into your mouth within three seconds of it being formed, or the chef’s feelings might get hurt.” (에반에게서 문자가 왔다. 이리나가 덤벨을 내려놓고 폰을 집어 들었다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> ([<b>Evan</b>: 방금 퇴근했어. 금방 갈게.])</p><p>Irina clumsily worked her chopsticks and flashed a mischievous smile. (이리나는 화면을 쳐다만 본 채 폰을 엎어버렸다. 한참 뒤 근육이 떨릴 정도로 몸을 혹사하고 나서야 마음이 조금 풀렸다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (전화를 걸어도, 신호음만 갈 뿐 에반은 받지 않았다.)</p><p>“This is sea urchin flown in all the way from Rebun Island.” (“이젠 전화까지 안 받겠다 이거지?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (다시 화가 치밀었다. 아무도 없는 거실 소파에 휙 옷을 던져 놓고 땀에 젖은 몸을 씻기 위해 샤워실로 들어갔다.)</p><p>The chef set down a gunkan-maki topped with golden sea urchin roe. (거친 물줄기가 머리 위로 쏟아지는 동안, 점심에 했던 말들이 떠올랐다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (<i>그래도 간만의 데이트였는데, 말이 너무 심했나.</i>)</p><p>“Hold on. I’m catching a strange signal in the background.” (샤워를 마치고 나오자 화면에 모르는 번호로 부재중 전화 3통이 떴다.)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (평소라면 무시했을 법했지만, 오늘따라 뒷덜미가 서늘해졌다. 옷을 걸치지도 않은 채 무언가에 홀린 듯 통화 버튼을 눌렀다.)</p><p>Evan replied half-heartedly, put the sushi in his mouth, and swallowed it after barely three chews. Even while putting the sushi in, his gaze was fixed on the iPhone, apparently tracking a red warning light flickering inside the security sandbox. (“이리나님? 에반님의 보호자 되십니까?”)</p><p><<<PARA>>> (알아듣지 못할 일본어 속에서 이리나는 제 이름만 듣고 영어로 대답했다.)</p><p>Irina set down her chopsticks and rested her chin on her hand. (“Yes, I’m Irina. item.title: Lee: "I tend to travel abroad quite often...Situations for local businesses and Korean residents quickly improve" (李 “순방 많이 다니는 편...현지 기업·교민 상황 신속 개선돼”)
item.description:
Lee: "I tend to travel abroad quite often...Situations for local businesses and Korean residents quickly improve" (李 “순방 많이 다니는 편...현지 기업·교민 상황 신속 개선돼”)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Brazil, said on the 28th (local time), "Actually, since taking office, I've been traveling abroad quite a bit," adding, "Meetings between national leaders greatly aid economic and security cooperation, as well as private-sector exchanges." <<> President Lee made these remarks at a gathering with compatriots held at a hotel in São Paulo, saying, "What's the point of traveling only at the end of my term? Even if we create new opportunities by then, the next administration might carry them forward, but it's not easy to make the most of them." He continued, "It's not about just making a formal visit and leaving; if we build real trust, the situation for local businesses, Korean residents, and companies exporting goods to this country quickly improves. He said, "Every single day of yours, everything you've done, has clearly built up to create today's proud Korean community in Brazil." <<> President Lee also shared other conversations he had with President Lula. It seems to be recovering again, and I hope you all play a big role in that and seize great opportunities to succeed." ()

item.title: [Exclusive] Military Guards GPs with Heavy Machine Guns Lacking Live Ammunition ([단독] ‘실탄’ 없는 중기관총으로 GP 경계 서는 軍)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Military Guards GPs with Heavy Machine Guns Lacking Live Ammunition ([단독] ‘실탄’ 없는 중기관총으로 GP 경계 서는 軍)

It was confirmed on the 28th that the Army's 1st Corps, which is located on the front lines of the western front facing North Korea and plays a key role in the defense of Seoul, is conducting guard operations without hanging ammunition belts loaded with live rounds on the 'K6 heavy machine guns' deployed at Guard Posts (GPs) and General Outposts (GOPs). Failing to attach live ammunition to the firearms raises significant concerns about a decreased ability to respond immediately in emergencies. Since North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un defined inter-Korean relations as "two hostile states in a state of war" at the end of 2023, North Korean troops have repeatedly crossed the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) to plant mines and install barbed wire, moving south, which has led to criticism that our military's vigilance posture is severely weakened. (북한과 마주한 서부 전선 최전방에 위치해 서울 방어에 핵심적 역할을 하는 육군 1군단이 전방 감시초소(GP)와 일반전초(GOP)에 배치된 ‘K6 중(重)기관총’에 실탄이 든 탄띠를 걸어 두지 않고 경계 작전을 하고 있는 것으로 28일 확인됐다. 실탄을 총기에 결합해 두지 않으면 유사시 즉각적 대처 능력이 떨어질 우려가 크다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 2023년 말 남북을 ‘교전 중인 적대적 두 국가’ 관계로 규정한 뒤, 북한군이 지뢰 매설과 철조망 설치 등을 위해 수차례 군사분계선(MDL)을 침범해 남하한 상황에서 우리 군의 경계 태세 약화가 심각하다는 지적이 제기된다.)

The Army Ground Operations Command, which oversees front-line corps including the 1st Corps, has a principle of maintaining a 'loaded' state for machine guns during guard duty, meaning an ammunition belt connected to multiple live rounds should be hung on the weapon. However, according to this newspaper's investigation, the 1st Corps reportedly changed its guard duty guidelines starting in the first half of this year, no longer loading the K6 heavy machine guns and instead keeping the ammunition cans containing the belts nearby. (1군단 등 전방 군단들을 관할하는 육군 지상작전사령부는 경계 근무 시 기관총에 여러 개의 실탄이 연결된 탄띠를 걸어 두는 ‘삽탄(揷彈)’ 상태 유지를 원칙으로 삼고 있다. 그러나 본지 취재를 종합하면 1군단은 올해 상반기부터 경계 근무 지침을 변경해 K6 중기관총에 삽탄을 하지 않고, 탄띠가 든 탄통을 옆에 비치해 두고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

The K6 heavy machine gun is a key standard weapon on our military's front lines, used to respond to contingencies such as North Korean troops firing on our guard posts or moving south. Without being loaded, soldiers must first retrieve the ammunition belt from the can and load it onto the K6 heavy machine gun before firing becomes possible. A retired general who served as a field commander said, "If a situation occurs at night, you'd have to turn on a flashlight and load live ammunition to fight; how can you take immediate action?" (K6 중기관총은 우리 군의 최전방 핵심 공용화기로, 북한군이 우리 감시초소에 총격을 가하거나 북한군이 남하하는 등의 유사시 대응에 쓰인다. 삽탄이 돼있지 않으면 상황 발생 후 우선 탄통에서 탄띠를 꺼내 K6 중기관총에 걸어야 비로소 사격이 가능해진다. 야전 지휘관으로 근무했던 예비역 장성은 “야간에 상황이 생기면 손전등에 불을 켜고 실탄을 장전해 싸워야 할 상황인데 어떻게 즉각 조치가 가능하겠나”라고 말했다.)

When asked by this newspaper about the reason for changing the guidelines, the 1st Corps did not respond. The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), which oversees front-line guard operations, told this newspaper, "The JCS neither received a report nor approved any changes to the relevant guidelines from the 1st Corps." It is said that the JCS was unaware of the 1st Corps' change in guard guidelines until they received this newspaper's inquiry. (1군단 측은 이처럼 지침을 변경한 이유를 묻는 본지 질의에 답변하지 않았다. 전방 경계 작전을 총괄하는 합동참모본부는 본지에 “합참은 관련 지침 변경에 대해 1군단으로부터 보고받거나 승인한 사실이 없다”고 했다. 합참은 본지 질의를 받기 전까지 1군단의 경계 지침 변경 사실을 알지 못했던 것으로 전해졌다.)

◇ In case of North Korean armed provocation, soldiers must find and load bullets before firing immediately (◇北 무력도발 땐, 즉각 사격 못하고 총알부터 찾아 넣어야)

The Army's 1st Corps, tasked with facing North Korean troops and defending the Imjin River estuary area and the northern outskirts of Seoul, is considered a key corps within the military due to its importance in capital defense. The change in guidelines for the 1st Corps, which now involves conducting guard duty without hanging ammunition belts loaded with live rounds on the K6 heavy machine guns, reportedly occurred after Lieutenant General Han Ki-seong assumed command in November last year. A graduate of the Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC), General Han gained attention as the first non-Korea Military Academy graduate to command the 1st Corps. (북한군을 마주하고 임진강 하구 일대와 서울 북쪽 외곽을 방어해야 하는 육군 1군단은 수도 방위에 미치는 중요성 때문에 군 내에서도 핵심 군단으로 꼽힌다. 이런 1군단이 K6 중기관총에 실탄이 든 탄띠를 걸어놓지 않고 경계 근무를 하는 방향으로 지침을 바꾼 것은 지난해 11월 한기성 군단장(중장)이 취임한 이후의 일로 알려졌다. 학군장교 출신인 한 군단장은 최초의 비(非)육군사관학교 출신 1군단장으로 주목받았다.)

Although the 1st Corps did not directly explain the background for suspending the loading of live ammunition, there is talk within the military that it may be intended to prevent K6 accidental discharges. On May 28 last year, at a GOP battalion under the 25th Division in Yangju, Gyeonggi Province, an accident occurred during an equipment inspection where one K6 live round was fired towards the North. The JCS explained at the time that the unit immediately broadcast the accidental discharge to the North, and there were no unusual movements from North Korean troops. At the time, General Han was serving as the commander of the 25th Division, which oversees the unit where the accident occurred. This background suggests that, having experienced the accidental discharge, the guidelines may have been changed to not hang the ammunition belt but keep the ammunition can next to the weapon. (1군단 측이 실탄 삽탄 중단 배경을 직접 설명하지는 않았지만, 군에서는 K6 오발 사고를 막기 위한 것 아니냐는 말이 나오고 있다. 지난해 5월 28일 경기 양주시의 25사단 예하 GOP 대대에서 총기 점검 도중 K6 실탄 1발이 북측으로 발사되는 사고가 있었다. 해당 부대는 상황 발생 즉시 북측으로 오발 사실을 알리는 방송을 했고, 북한군의 특이 동향은 없었다고 당시 합참은 설명했다. 이때 한 군단장은 사고가 발생한 부대를 관할하는 25사단장을 지내고 있었다. 오발 사고를 겪었기에 탄띠를 걸어두지 않고, 탄통을 총기 옆에 두는 것으로 지침을 변경했을 수 있다는 얘기가 나오는 배경이다.)

The K6 heavy machine gun, which uses 12.7mm rounds, has the largest caliber among all firearms in our military. Its effective range is about 1.8 km, more than three times longer than the K2 rifle's 5.56mm caliber. As it is used for proportional response in case of North Korean provocations, it is widely deployed at front-line guard posts, armored vehicles, and naval vessels. When North Korean troops came south across the MDL in the central front area last August while working on 'border line painting' in the inter-Korean border zone, our military also used K6 heavy machine guns for warning shots. At that time, North Korea claimed under the name of Ri Yong-sik, Deputy Chief of the General Staff of the North Korean People's Army, that "the South Korean warmongers committed a grave provocative act by firing over ten rounds of warning shots from 12.7mm large-caliber machine guns at North Korean soldiers permanently building barriers near the southern border line." (12.7㎜탄을 쓰는 K6 중기관총은 우리 군이 가진 총기 중 가장 구경(口徑)이 크다. 유효 사거리도 약 1.8㎞ 정도로 5.56㎜ 구경의 K2 소총보다 3배 이상 길다. 북한 도발 시 비례적 대응에 활용되는 만큼 전방 초소와 장갑차, 해군 함정 등에 광범위하게 배치돼 있다. 지난해 8월 남북 접경 지대의 ‘국경선화’ 작업을 하던 북한군이 중부전선 일대에서 군사분계선(MDL)을 넘어 남하했을 때, 우리 군이 경고 사격에 사용한 것도 K6 중기관총이었다. 이때 북한은 고정철 북한군 총참모부 부총참모장 명의로 “한국군 호전광들이 남쪽 국경선 부근에서 차단물 영구화 공사를 하는 북한 군인들에게 12.7㎜ 대구경 기관총으로 10여 발의 경고 사격을 가하는 엄중한 도발 행위를 감행했다”고 주장했다.)

Inside and outside the military, there is talk that concerns about K6 accidental discharges on the front lines may have unnecessarily grown due to the current government's emphasis on restoring inter-Korean trust. A military official said, "To prevent accidents with shots fired towards the North, they probably thought 'just don't load the ammunition.'" They added, "The very idea of removing ammunition from standard weapons at front-line units out of fear of accidental discharges reveals a lack of security awareness." (군 안팎에서는 남북 신뢰 회복을 강조하는 현 정부의 기조로 인해 K6 오발 사고에 대한 일선의 우려가 불필요하게 커졌을 수 있다는 말도 나온다. 군 관계자는 “북측으로 오발되는 사고를 예방하려면 ‘삽탄을 하지 않으면 된다’는 생각을 한 것 아니겠냐”며 “오발 사고가 무서워서 전방 부대의 공용화기 탄을 뺀다는 발상 자체가 안보 의식 부족을 드러낸다”고 했다.)

Beyond the issue of the 1st Corps changing its guard guidelines to stop loading K6 ammunition, there are also voices criticizing that the JCS failed to detect such a change at a key corps in advance and only learned of it through media coverage. It is known that the Army Ground Operations Command, which the 1st Corps belongs to, was aware of the guideline change but did not relay it to the JCS. This raises concerns that internal military communication has serious problems. A military source said, "It's possible that the JCS Chairman, who comes from the Air Force, lacks understanding and interest in front-line ground guard operations." (1군단이 K6 삽탄을 중단하기로 경계 지침을 변경한 것도 문제지만, 합참이 핵심 군단의 그런 변화를 사전에 파악하지 못하고, 언론 취재를 통해 알았다는 것도 문제라는 목소리도 나온다. 1군단이 소속된 육군 지상작전사령부는 지침 변경 사실을 인지했지만, 합참에 전달하지는 않았던 것으로 알려졌다. 군 내부 소통에 심각한 문제가 있다는 방증이라는 우려가 나온다. 군 소식통은 “공군 출신인 합참의장의 전방 지상 경계 작전에 대한 이해와 관심이 부족한 것 아니냐”고 말했다.)

The JCS has belatedly begun a comprehensive investigation into guard operation guidelines across front-line corps. Currently, it appears that only the 1st Corps among front-line units has issued guidelines to stop loading standard weapons. The 2nd, 3rd, and 5th Corps have not changed their guidelines, which still require standard weapons to be loaded during guard duty. The military allows corps commanders to adjust detailed guard operation guidelines considering various operational environments. The JCS is reportedly taking the position that it will determine whether the 1st Corps commander's change of guard guidelines falls within his authority. (합참은 뒤늦게 전방 군단 경계 작전 지침에 대한 전반적인 조사에 나섰다. 현재 공용화기 삽탄 중단 지침을 내린 전방 군단은 1군단 뿐인 것으로 알려졌다. 2·3·5군단은 경계 근무 시 공용화기 삽탄을 하는 지침에 변동이 없다는 것이다. 군은 다양한 작전 환경을 고려해 세부 경계 작전 지침은 군단장이 변경할 수 있도록 하고 있다. 합참은 1군단장의 경계 지침 변경이 군단장 권한 안에서 이뤄진 것인지 따져보겠다는 입장인 것으로 전해졌다.)

Shin Jong-woo, Secretary-General of the Korea Defense and Security Forum (KODEF), said, "Even though North Korea is escalating tensions by fortifying the MDL, front-line units are conducting guard duty without even loading live ammunition in machine guns." He added, "It inevitably raises doubts about whether immediate response is possible in a contingency." (신종우 한국국방안보포럼(KODEF) 사무총장은 “북한이 군사분계선을 요새화하며 긴장을 고조시키는데도 최전방 부대가 기관총에 실탄 삽탄조차 하지 않고 경계근무를 하고 있다”며 “유사시 즉각적인 대응이 가능할지 의문이 들 수밖에 없다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Dishonorably Discharged for Involvement in Martial Law, Yet Special Counsel Concludes "No Charges" ([단독] 비상계엄 연루됐다고 불명예 전역 당했는데 특검은 “무혐의” 결론)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Dishonorably Discharged for Involvement in Martial Law, Yet Special Counsel Concludes "No Charges" ([단독] 비상계엄 연루됐다고 불명예 전역 당했는데 특검은 “무혐의” 결론)

The Ministry of National Defense issued a heavy disciplinary action of two months' suspension against former Ground Operations Commander (Army General) Joo Seong-woon, citing suspicions of his involvement in the December 3 emergency martial law. However, it was reported on the 28th that the special counsel recently cleared him of all charges. Former Commander Joo, who was promoted to general after President Lee Jae-myung took office but was abruptly removed from duty five months later, was discharged on the 14th under regulations that automatically discharge generals who have not been assigned to a position beyond a certain period. Despite the no-charge ruling, the Ministry of National Defense has no plans to revoke the disciplinary action. A Ministry official told this newspaper, "Regardless of the investigation results, the grounds for disciplinary action can be recognized." (국방부가 12·3 비상계엄에 연루된 의혹이 있다며 정직 2개월의 중징계를 했던 주성운 전 지상작전사령관(육군 대장)이 최근 특검에서 무혐의 처분을 받은 것으로 28일 전해졌다. 이재명 대통령 취임 후 대장 승진을 했다가 5개월 만에 돌연 직무배제됐던 주 전 사령관은 일정 기간 이상 보직을 받지 못한 장성을 자동으로 전역 조치하는 규정에 따라 지난 14일 전역 조치됐다. 무혐의 처분에도 국방부는 징계를 직권 취소할 계획이 없는 것으로 전해졌다. 국방부 관계자는 본지에 “수사 결과와는 별개로 징계 사유가 인정될 수 있다”고 했다.)

According to a compilation of this newspaper's reporting on the 28th, the second comprehensive special counsel (Special Prosecutor Kwon Chang-young) is said to have recently informed former Commander Joo that there were no charges against him and that the case would not be prosecuted. On February 12, the Ministry of National Defense, through its "Constitutional Respect and Government Reform Task Force," which investigated involvement in the martial law, found that former Commander Joo's suspicions of involvement were confirmed, and subsequently removed him from duty and requested an investigation. (28일 본지 취재를 종합하면 2차 종합특검(특별검사 권창영) 측은 최근 주 전 사령관에게 혐의가 없어 불기소한다는 입장을 통보한 것으로 알려졌다. 지난 2월 12일 국방부는 계엄 참여·협조 여부를 조사하는 ‘헌법 존중 정부 혁신 TF’ 활동을 통해 주 전 사령관의 계엄 연루 혐의가 확인됐다며 직무배제하고 수사 의뢰했다.)

The Ministry's Task Force reportedly raised suspicions that former Commander Joo, who was the 1st Corps Commander (Lieutenant General) at the time of the martial law, may have known about the martial law plan in advance, as he had a phone call with his direct subordinate, then-Army 2nd Armored Brigade Commander (Brigadier General) Koo Sam-hoe, but did not issue an order to return. Former Brigade Commander Koo had taken leave before the martial law and participated in the so-called "Lotteria Meeting" led by former Intelligence Commander Noh Sang-won on the day of the martial law. The comprehensive special counsel reportedly determined that there was no evidence to support the suspicions against former Commander Joo. (국방부 TF는 계엄 당시 1군단장(중장)이었던 주 전 사령관이 자신의 직속 부하였던 구삼회 당시 육군 2기갑여단장(준장)과 통화했으면서도 복귀 지시를 하지 않았던 점 등을 볼 때 계엄 계획을 사전에 알았던 것 아니냐는 의혹을 제기했던 것으로 알려졌다. 구삼회 전 단장은 계엄 전 휴가를 내고, 계엄 당일 노상원 전 정보사령관이 주도한 이른바 ‘롯데리아 회동’에 참여했다. 종합특검은 주 전 사령관에 대한 의혹을 뒷받침할 증거가 없다고 판단한 것으로 전해졌다.)

However, earlier this month, the Ministry of National Defense issued a heavy disciplinary action of two months' suspension to former Commander Joo, citing a violation of "duty of fidelity." Notably, former Joint Chiefs of Staff Operations Chief Lee Seung-oh, who was dismissed by the Ministry on suspicions of involvement in the martial law, and former Navy Chief of Staff Kang Dong-gil, who received a heavy disciplinary action of one month's suspension, also received no-charge rulings from the special counsel. The Ministry is not considering revoking the disciplinary actions against them either. (하지만 국방부는 이달 초 ‘성실 의무’를 위반했다며 주 전 사령관에게 정직 2개월 중징계를 내렸다. 앞서 국방부가 계엄 연루 의혹으로 파면한 이승오 전 합참 작전본부장과 정직 1개월의 중징계 처분을 했던 강동길 전 해군참모총장도 모두 특검의 무혐의 처분을 받았다. 국방부는 이들에 대한 징계 직권 취소도 검토하지 않고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Korea and Brazil, Optimal Partners... Synergy through Civil Aircraft, Critical Minerals, K-Beauty" (李대통령 “韓·브라질, 최적 파트너...민항기·핵심광물·K뷰티로 시너지")
item.description:
President Lee: "Korea and Brazil, Optimal Partners... Synergy through Civil Aircraft, Critical Minerals, K-Beauty" (李대통령 “韓·브라질, 최적 파트너...민항기·핵심광물·K뷰티로 시너지")

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Brazil, said on the 28th (local time), "If Korea's unrivaled innovative technology and manufacturing capabilities join forces with Brazil's abundant resources, the two countries will be able to leap forward as optimal partners that jointly lead stable supply chains and future industries." ()

President Lee made this remark during a keynote speech at a 'Business Roundtable' event held in São Paulo, Brazil's economic hub, with about 40 business leaders from both countries in attendance, stating, "As global uncertainty increases, finding partners who can leverage each other's strengths to create synergy is more important than ever." (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 28일(현지 시각) “한국의 독보적인 혁신 기술과 제조 역량, 브라질의 풍부한 자원이 힘을 합친다면 양국은 안정적인 공급망과 미래 산업을 함께 이끄는 최적의 파트너로 도약할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee highlighted 'joint development of civil aircraft,' 'supply chain cooperation in critical minerals,' and the 'K-Beauty industry,' which is gaining popularity in Brazil, as key areas where Korea and Brazil can collaborate to generate synergy. (이 대통령은 이날 브라질의 경제 중심지인 상파울루에서 양국 경제인 등 40여 명이 참석한 가운데 열린 ‘비즈니스 라운드 테이블’ 행사 기조 발언에서 “글로벌 불확실성이 높아질수록 서로의 강점을 활용해 시너지를 낼 수 있는 파트너를 만나는 것이 그 어느 때보다도 중요하다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee said, "Brazil possesses world-class capabilities in producing small and medium-sized civil aircraft," adding, "It is a treasure trove of critical minerals such as lithium, nickel, and iron ore essential for high-tech industries, and it is also an energy powerhouse leading the clean energy and bioethanol markets." (이 대통령은 한국과 브라질이 협력해 시너지를 낼 수 있는 주요 분야로 ‘민항기 공동 개발’과 ‘핵심 광물 분야에서의 공급망 협력’, 그리고 브라질에서 인기를 끌고 있는 ‘K뷰티 산업’을 꼽았다.)

President Lee then stated, "If businesspeople from both countries pool their efforts, Korea and Brazil will be able to grow together as an aircraft manufacturing powerhouse that leads the global aviation market, an important partner in supply chain cooperation, and further, a leader in the global beauty market." (이 대통령은 “브라질은 세계 최고 수준의 중소형 민항기 생산 역량을 보유하고 있다”며 “첨단 산업에 필수인 리튬, 니켈, 철광석 등 핵심 광물의 보고이자, 청정 에너지에 바이오에탄올 시장까지 선도하고 있는 에너지 강국이기도 하다”고 했다.)

President Lee also noted, "Considering the economic scale of both countries, the potential for economic cooperation is very large." Last year, trade volume between Korea and Brazil amounted to $14.3 billion (approximately 20 trillion won), ranking 21st among Korea's trading partners. Regarding this situation, President Lee commented, "Compared to the potential, (the current level) can be said to be very small." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “양국 기업인들이 힘을 모아주신다면 한국과 브라질은 글로벌 항공 시장을 주도할 항공기 제조 강국이자, 공급망 협력에 중요한 파트너, 나아가 글로벌 뷰티 시장의 선도자로 동반 성장할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Attending this event from the Korean side were Ryu Jin, Chairman of the Korea Economic Association (FKI); Chung Euisun, Chairman of Hyundai Motor Group; Jang In-hwa, Chairman of POSCO; Cho Won-tae, Chairman of Korean Air; Park Seung-hee, President of Samsung Electronics; Ryu Jae-cheol, CEO of LG Electronics; Lee Dong-hoon, CEO of SK Biopharm; Jung In-seop, President of Hanwha Ocean; Moon Jae-young, CEO of HD Hyundai Construction Equipment; and Choi Soo-yeon, CEO of Naver. <<> From the Brazilian side, attendees included Francisco Gomes Neto, CEO of Embraer; Anderson Fernandes, Vice President of WEG; and Jereissati Okelehan, Chairman of JBS. (이 대통령은 “양국의 경제 규모를 고려할 때 경제 협력의 잠재력이 매우 크다”고도 했다. 지난해 한국과 브라질의 교역액은 143억달러(약 20조원)로 우리와 교역하는 국가 중 21위였다. 이 대통령은 이 같은 상황에 대해 “잠재력에 비하면 (현재는) 매우 적다고 할 수 있겠다”고 했다.)

In his greeting, FKI Chairman Ryu Jin said, "I hope that today marks the launch of a 'One Team' for Korea and Brazil." When asked by reporters about the outlook for the Brazilian market, Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung Euisun responded, "China is also pushing hard (for entry)," and added, "We still have a long way to go." (이날 행사에는 한국 측에서 류진 한국경제인협회 회장, 정의선 현대차그룹 회장, 장인화 포스코 회장, 조원태 대한항공 회장, 박승희 삼성전자 사장, 류재철 LG전자 대표, 이동훈 SK바이오팜 대표, 정인섭 한화오션 사장, 문재영 HD건설기계 대표, 최수연 네이버 대표 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Stock Price Fluctuations Will Be Reviewed Comprehensively...It's Not Just Us" (김용범 “주가 변동, 전반적으로 점검할 것...우리만 그런 것은 아냐”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "Stock Price Fluctuations Will Be Reviewed Comprehensively...It's Not Just Us" (김용범 “주가 변동, 전반적으로 점검할 것...우리만 그런 것은 아냐”)

Kim Yong-beom, the head of the policy office at the presidential office, stated on the 28th (local time) regarding the recent sharp fluctuations in the domestic stock market, "Over the past 2-3 months, it hasn't been just us." He noted that stock markets globally have been volatile. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 28일(현지 시각) 최근 국내 증시의 급등락에 대해 “지난 2~3개월은 우리만 그런 것은 아니다”라고 말했다. 전 세계적으로 증시가 출렁였다는 것이다.)

Director Kim responded to a question about the stock market during a briefing in Brazil, where President Lee Jae-myung was on a state visit. While saying this, he added about leveraged Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), which have been cited as a cause for the high volatility in the domestic market, "We plan to have the Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service examine not only leveraged ETFs but also overall structural factors that make volatility particularly pronounced." (김 실장은 이재명 대통령이 국빈 방문한 브라질 현지 브리핑에서 주식 시장 관련 질문이 나오자 이같이 답했다. 김 실장은 그러면서도 국내 증시 변동성이 큰 원인으로 지목된 단일종목 레버리지 상징지수펀드(ETF) 등에 대해 “변동성이 유독 도드라지는 구조적 요인에 대해 레버리지 상장지수펀드뿐 아니라 전반적으로 금융위원회, 금융감독원에서 점검해보려고 한다”고 했다.)

Director Kim said, "If market volatility is at a level of 10, the phenomenon where it appears at a level of 20-30 in our country might be due to amplification by the characteristics of our market." He described the characteristics of our market as "a high proportion of individual investors, dynamic investment patterns, and many related derivative products," adding, "These factors, combined with the very large market share of two companies (Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix), have led to significant volatility." (김 실장은 “증시 변동이 10 정도 되는데, 우리나라에서 20~30으로 나타나는 현상은 우리가 가지고 있는 시장 특성 때문에 증폭되는 것일 수 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 우리 시장의 특징으로 “개인 투자자 비중이 크고, 역동적으로 투자하고, 관련된 파생상품이 많다”며 “(여기에) 두 회사(삼성전자, SK하이닉스)가 시장에서 차지하는 비중이 매우 큰 특성이 맞물리면서 변동성이 크게 나타났다”고 했다.)

Regarding the repeated sharp rises and falls in semiconductor stocks, Director Kim said, "Debates continue over the overall trajectory of semiconductor and AI (artificial intelligence) stocks," and added that it remains to be seen whether semiconductor companies will continue to perform well or will show signs of entering a so-called 'cycle'. (김 실장은 반도체주의 주가가 크게 오르락내리락을 반복하는 데 대해선 “반도체, AI(인공지능)주 전체의 향배를 둘러싼 논쟁이 계속되고 있다”며 반도체 회사의 실적이 계속 좋을지, 아니면 이른바 ‘사이클’을 타는 모습을 보일지는 지켜봐야 한다고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "Cho Jeong-sik Got Caught by a Reporter... I'll Tell Him to Do Better" (정청래 “조정식, 기자에게 낚인 것…앞으로 잘하라고 하겠다”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae: "Cho Jeong-sik Got Caught by a Reporter... I'll Tell Him to Do Better" (정청래 “조정식, 기자에게 낚인 것…앞으로 잘하라고 하겠다”)

Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 29th regarding National Assembly Speaker Cho Jeong-sik, "It seems he got caught by reporters. The media has dragged him into this in a way that's good for their business." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표 후보가 조정식 국회의장을 두고 “기자들에게 낚인 것 같다. 언론이 장사하기 좋게 말려들었다”고 29일 말했다.)

The previous day, during his first press conference since taking office, Speaker Cho stated, "The issue of (constitutional amendment for a sitting president's reelection) is a bit premature to discuss in detail, isn't it?" and added, "In the reorganization of the power structure, the matter of amending the constitution for a sitting president's reelection ultimately comes down to the choice of the sovereign people," drawing criticism that he might be opening the door to the possibility of President Lee Jae-myung's reelection. (전날 조 의장은 취임 후 첫 기자간담회에서 “(현직 대통령 연임 개헌) 문제는 이러쿵저러쿵 시기상조 아닌가”라면서 “권력 구조 개편에서 현직 대통령 연임 개헌 문제는 결국 주권자 국민 선택”이라고 말해 이재명 대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어둔 것이 아니냐는 비판이 나왔다.)

Candidate Jeong said on CBS Radio, "He simply said, 'I will follow the will of the people,' but he probably didn't expect it would escalate like this. It seems the National Assembly Speaker is a bit weak on details." (정 후보는 이날 CBS라디오에서 “‘국민들의 뜻을 따르겠다’고 얘기한 것인데 이렇게 비화될 줄은 몰랐을 것”이라며 “국회의장이 디테일에 좀 약한 것 같다”고 했다.)

He also added, "The reporters were probably eagerly watching to see how he would respond to such a question. If it were me, I would have said this. If he had said, 'That's impossible under Article 128 of the Constitution,' it would have been neatly resolved." (또 “(기자들이) 눈을 불을 켜고 어떻게 답변하나 이렇게 물어보는 사안이었을 텐데, 저 같으면 이렇게 했을 것 같다. ‘그것은 헌법 128조상 불가능한 일’이라고 말씀하셨으면 깔끔하게 정리되었을 것”이라고도 했다.)

He further stated, "I plan to tell Speaker Cho to do better from now on." (덧붙여 “조 국회의장에게 앞으로 제가 잘하라고 하겠다”고도 말했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil also criticized Speaker Cho's remarks that day. Appearing on MBC News Today, Candidate Song said, "Speaker Cho's remarks are open to misunderstanding. They are inappropriate. Even within the ruling party, it's hard to agree with them." (이날 송영길 후보 역시 조 의장의 발언에 대해 지적했다. 송 후보는 MBC 뉴스투데이에 출연해 “조 의장의 발언은 오해의 소지가 있다”며 “부적절하다. 여당 내부에서도 동의가 어렵다”고 했다.)

He also said, "President Lee has clearly stated that a sitting president is not subject to constitutional amendment under Article 128, Clause 2 of the Constitution." (또 “이 대통령도 확실하게 얘기했다. 현직 대통령은 헌법 128조 2항에 따라 헌법 개정의 대상이 되지 않는다고 규정됐다”고도 말했다.)

Damage control also continued within the ruling camp. Supreme Council member Kang Deok-gu said at the Supreme Council meeting that day, "Let me be clear. Extending the term of a sitting president is not a subject for constitutional amendment discussions." (여권 내에서도 수습이 이어졌다. 강득구 최고위원은 이날 최고위원회의에서 “분명히 말씀 드린다. 현직 대통령 임기 연장은 개헌 논의 대상이 아니다”라고 했다.)

Supreme Council candidate Im Mi-ae also said on MBC Radio, "Wasn't it a mistake during the press conference? It seems he issued a separate statement right after that. There was plenty of room for misunderstanding, and in that regard, he made a mistake." (임미애 최고위원 후보도 MBC라디오에서 “기자간담회에서 실수하신 것 아니냐. 그뒤에 곧바로 따로 입장을 내신 것 같다. 오해할 수 있는 여지가 충분히 있었던 거고, 그래서 그런 면에 있어서는 잘못하신 것”이라고 했다.)

National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo also said on SBS Radio in response to a question about whether it wouldn't apply to President Lee Jae-myung, "If we amend the constitution, we'd have to go that way." <<>> (서영교 법사위원장도 SBS라디오에서 이재명 대통령은 적용이 안되냐는 물음에 “개헌하면 그렇게 가야죠”라고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "Democratic Party, Stop Attempting to Force Through 'Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers'" (국힘 “민주, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 강행 처리 시도 중단하라”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "Democratic Party, Stop Attempting to Force Through 'Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers'" (국힘 “민주, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 강행 처리 시도 중단하라”)

The People Power Party (PPP) on the 29th opposed the passage of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, which aims to abolish the prosecutor's supplementary investigation powers, led by the ruling party in the legislative subcommittee of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, stating, "Stop the forced processing immediately." (국민의힘은 29일 검사의 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 한 형사소송법 개정안이 여당 주도로 국회 법사위 소위에서 통과되자 “강행 처리 시도를 즉각 중단하라”며 반발했다.)

PPP lawmakers on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee said at a press conference in the Assembly, "The Democratic Party must immediately stop its attempt to force through the Criminal Procedure Act amendment," and demanded, "Hold a public hearing with participation from both ruling and opposition parties to gather opinions from the legal community, academia, investigative field, and victims." (국회 법사위 소속 국민의힘 의원들은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “민주당은 형사소송법 개정안 강행 처리 시도를 즉각 중단하라”며 “여야가 함께 참여하는 공청회를 개최하여 법조계·학계·수사 현장과 피해자들의 의견을 수렴하라”고 했다.)

They also announced plans to submit a request to form an agenda coordination committee at the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee scheduled for that day. The agenda coordination committee is a system that allows up to 90 days of deliberation on contentious bills. This committee must be composed of three members each from the ruling and opposition parties, and if four or more members agree, the agenda can be processed immediately. (그러면서 이날 열릴 예정인 법사위 전체회의에서 안건조정위원회 구성 요구서를 제출할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 안건조정위는 이견 있는 법안 처리 시 최장 90일간 법안을 숙의할 수 있도록 한 제도다. 안건조정위는 여야 조정위원을 3명씩 동수로 구성해야 하는데, 4명 이상 찬성하면 바로 안건 처리가 가능하다.)

PPP lawmakers stated, "The Democratic Party and Legislation and Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-kyo should form an agenda coordination committee to ensure a 90-day review period in line with the purpose of the legal provisions, so that both parties can collaboratively devise effective alternatives to protect victims and prevent investigative gaps," adding, "The People Power Party promises the public that, as the last bastion protecting the lives and safety of the people, we will fight against reckless legislative rampage with all available means." (국민의힘 의원들은 “민주당과 서영교 법사위원장은 피해자 보호와 수사 공백 방지를 위한 실효적 대안을 여야가 함께 마련할 수 있도록 안건조정위를 구성하여 법 규정의 취지에 맞게 90일의 심사 기간을 보장해야 할 것”이라며 “국민의힘은 국민의 생명과 안전을 지키는 최후의 보루로서 무모한 입법 폭주에 맞서 모든 수단을 다해 싸울 것임을 국민 여러분께 약속드린다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government Ends ‘Emergency Economic Review Meeting’ on Middle East War Response: “State of Emergency Continues… Deputy Prime Minister for Economy to Take Charge” (정부, 중동 전쟁 대응 ‘비상경제점검회의’ 종료 “비상 상황은 계속… 경제부총리가 대응”)
item.description:
Government Ends ‘Emergency Economic Review Meeting’ on Middle East War Response: “State of Emergency Continues… Deputy Prime Minister for Economy to Take Charge” (정부, 중동 전쟁 대응 ‘비상경제점검회의’ 종료 “비상 상황은 계속… 경제부총리가 대응”)

The government suspended on the 29th the presidential and prime ministerial-level ‘Emergency Economic Review Meeting’ that had been activated to address the economic impact of the Middle East war. However, the government clarified that this does not mean the crisis situation resulting from the Middle East war has ended. (정부가 중동 전쟁으로 인한 경제 영향에 대응한다며 가동한 대통령·총리급 ‘비상경제점검회의’를 29일 중단했다. 다만 정부는 중동 전쟁으로 인한 위기 상황이 끝났다고 보는 것은 아니라고 했다.)

The government convened the 16th Emergency Economic Review Meeting on this morning at the Government Seoul Complex, chaired by Prime Minister Han Sung-sook. At the meeting, Prime Minister Han stated, “We will conclude the Emergency Economic Review Meeting today and shift to a structure where the (Deputy Prime Minister for) Economy will be responsible for matters related to the Middle East war.” (정부는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 한성숙 국무총리 주재로 16차 비상경제점검회의를 열었다. 이 자리에서 한 총리는 “비상 경제 점검 회의는 오늘로 마감하고, (경제)부총리가 중동 전쟁 관련 상황을 책임지는 구조로 바꾸고자 한다”고 했다.)

The government declared the activation of an ‘Emergency Economic Response System’ on March 25th, following the outbreak of war between the United States and Iran on February 28th and the expansion of combat zones to most of the Middle East. The highest control tower was the Emergency Economic Review Meeting chaired by President Lee Jae-myung, and an ‘Emergency Economic Headquarters’ was established to support this, headed by the Prime Minister. The headquarters included five practical response teams: the ‘Macroeconomics/Price Response Team,’ the ‘Energy Supply Team,’ the ‘Financial Stability Team,’ the ‘People’s Livelihood and Welfare Team,’ and the ‘Overseas Situation Management Team.’ The Deputy Prime Minister for Economy, along with the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Chairman of the Financial Services Commission, the Minister of Health and Welfare, and the Minister of Foreign Affairs, each took charge of a team, leading the monitoring and response to related situations. <<> However, as the U.S. and Iran entered into ceasefire negotiations, President Lee transferred the Emergency Economic Review Meeting to Prime Minister Han on the 30th of last month, and Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol took over as the head of the Emergency Economic Headquarters. With the suspension of the Emergency Economic Review Meeting today, the only remaining government consultative body regarding the Middle East war within the government is the Emergency Economic Headquarters meeting chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Koo. <<> Prime Minister Han stated that the crisis situation resulting from the Middle East war is not over. He remarked, “We are in a situation where armed conflict between the U.S. and Iran, along with temporary suspensions, are repeating. The nature of the conflict is becoming more complex, and its scope appears to be expanding, including the potential blockade of the Red Sea.” <<> Prime Minister Han added that the suspension of the Emergency Economic Review Meeting is intended for role division between the Prime Minister and the Deputy Prime Minister. Prime Minister Han said, “Let the Deputy Prime Minister for Science and Technology oversee technology-related meetings and tasks centered on AI (artificial intelligence), and let the two Deputy Prime Ministers (for Economy and for Science and Technology) clarify their respective areas of responsibility. I will generally monitor whether the work of each ministry is proceeding smoothly and focus on matters related to social ministries.” He continued, “I also intend to reduce the time deputy ministers spend attending various meetings so they can focus on their core duties—eliminating what should be eliminated and changing what should be changed.” <<> Regarding the government’s response to the Middle East war, Prime Minister Han assessed, “So far, the government has responded nimbly to protect the people’s livelihoods from the shock of international oil price fluctuations through measures such as the maximum oil price policy and fuel tax cuts.” He added, “By proactively managing the energy supply chain, we have secured 110% of the August crude oil volume compared to last year, and have also secured over 90% of the September volume. Despite the difficulties, our country is wisely overcoming the crisis by achieving an economic growth rate of 3.8% in the first half of this year compared to last year.” <<> Prime Minister Han stated, “However, as the state of emergency continues, I ask for constant monitoring of whether the crisis response measures taken so far are being implemented consistently. Please also check whether the crackdown and punishment of market order disruptions—such as hoarding and collusion—are being carried out properly, and whether improvements to related systems, like the Price Stability Act, are progressing without any hitches.” (정부는 2월 28일 미국과 이란 간 전쟁이 발발하고 교전 지역이 중동 대부분으로 확대되자 3월 25일 ‘비상 경제 대응 체계’ 가동을 선언했다. 이재명 대통령이 주재하는 비상경제점검회의를 최고 컨트롤타워로 하고, 이를 뒷받침하기 위해 총리를 본부장으로 하는 ‘비상경제본부’를 만들었다. 본부에는 ‘거시경제/물가대응반’ ‘에너지수급반’ ‘금융안정반’ ‘민생복지반’ ‘해외상황관리반’ 등 5개 실무 대응반을 뒀고, 경제부총리와 산업통상부 장관, 금융위원장, 보건복지부 장관, 외교부 장관이 각 반을 맡아서 관련 상황 점검과 대응을 주도했다.)

item.title: "We Will Process the Criminal Procedure Act, National Assembly Act, and Election Commission Special Counsel Law at the 30th Plenary Session" (與 “30일 본회의서 형소법·국회법·선관위특검법 처리할 것")
item.description:
"We Will Process the Criminal Procedure Act, National Assembly Act, and Election Commission Special Counsel Law at the 30th Plenary Session" (與 “30일 본회의서 형소법·국회법·선관위특검법 처리할 것")

The Democratic Party of Korea announced that at the plenary session to be held on the 30th, it will process the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to abolish supplementary investigation powers, the National Assembly Act, which shortens the processing days for fast-track bills, and the Election Commission Special Counsel Law. (더불어민주당이 30일 열리는 본회의에서 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 한 형사소송법, 패스트트랙(신속처리법안) 처리 일수를 단축하는 국회법, 선관위 특검법 등을 처리하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Kang Joon-hyun, Senior Spokesperson of the Democratic Party, met with reporters immediately after the Supreme Council meeting on the 29th and stated, "The plenary session is scheduled for tomorrow (30th). We plan to process the Criminal Procedure Act, National Assembly Act, and Election Commission Special Counsel Law on-site." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 29일 최고위원회의 직후 기자들과 만나 “내일(30일) 본회의가 예정돼있다. 형소법, 국회법, 선관위특검법 현장서 처리할 계획에 있다”고 했다.)

The Criminal Procedure Act is a bill that completely abolishes the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, leaving only the authority to request supplementary investigations from the police. (형사소송법은 검찰의 보완수사권을 완전 폐지하고, 경찰에게 보완 수사를 요구하는 권한만 남겨놓는 법안이다.)

The amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which passed the Legislative Judiciary Subcommittee led by the Democratic Party the day before, also added grounds for dismissing the prosecution rights of prosecutors in public prosecution offices. These include "when a prosecution is filed based on a serious illegal investigation" and "when a prosecution is filed with a significant deviation from prosecutorial discretion." This aims to restrict not only the prosecution's investigation powers but also their prosecution rights. (전날 민주당 주도로 법사소위를 통과한 형소법 개정안에는 공소청 검사들의 공소권을 기각하는 사유도 추가됐다. ‘중대한 위법수사에 기해 공소가 제기됐을 때’ ‘소추재량권을 현저히 일탈해 공소가 제기됐을 때’다. 검사의 수사권뿐만 아니라 공소권 역시 제한하겠다는 것이다.)

Additionally, the National Assembly Act's key point is to reduce the current fast-track bill process, which takes a total of 330 days (180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days in the plenary session), to 60 days in standing committees, 30 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and processing at the first plenary session after being placed on the agenda. In other words, it aims to shorten the processing time of fast-track bills from 330 days to about 90 days. (또 국회법은 현행 패스트트랙 법안이 상임위원회 180일, 법사위 90일, 본회의 60일 등 총 330일 소요되는 것을 상임위 60일, 법사위 30일, 본회의 부의 후 첫 개의 본회의 시 처리하는 내용이 골자다. 즉 패스트트랙 법안 처리 시일을 330일을 90여일로 단축하겠다는 것이다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "Regarding the Election Commission Special Counsel Law, the ruling and opposition parties have roughly agreed on the investigation personnel and duration, but they are still in final negotiations over the scope and targets of the investigation." (강 수석대변인은 “선관특검법 관련해선 수사인력, 기간 여야 대략 합의봤지만 수사 대상, 범위 관련해 여야가 아직 막바지 협상 중”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs: "Term Extension Constitutional Amendment Impossible… Jeong Seong-ho Must Serve Until the Launch of the Public Prosecution Service" (靑 정무수석 “연임 개헌 불가능… 정성호, 공소청 출범 때까진 역할 해야”)
item.description:
Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs: "Term Extension Constitutional Amendment Impossible… Jeong Seong-ho Must Serve Until the Launch of the Public Prosecution Service" (靑 정무수석 “연임 개헌 불가능… 정성호, 공소청 출범 때까진 역할 해야”)

Hong Ik-pyo, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs, stated on the 29th regarding the controversy over National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s remarks on a "presidential term extension constitutional amendment" that "under the current constitution, an amendment including a term extension for the incumbent president is practically impossible." Appearing on MBC Radio's 'Kim Jong-bae's Spotlight', Secretary Hong said, "The constitution stipulates that the incumbent president is not bound by matters related to constitutional amendments." <<> In relation to Speaker Woo's remarks, Secretary Hong stated, "This is not about pursuing a term extension or 'asking the public's will.' While all constitutional matters will be put to the public's judgment according to their will, the Speaker's office has reaffirmed the position that term extension is impossible under the current constitution." He added, "Some are spinning conspiracy theories, claiming it's coordinated with the Blue House, but that's completely untrue. It has never happened. A term extension constitutional amendment has never crossed my mind, nor have I ever considered it possible." <<> He emphasized, "The President is already well aware that a term extension constitutional amendment is not feasible and has repeatedly stated this." He further noted, "When the People Power Party claimed the President didn't answer about term extension during the recent luncheon with party leaders, the President responded, 'The opposition holds the constitutional amendment threshold, and it's impossible under the current constitution. How could it be feasible?' It's inappropriate to push one-sided narratives." <<> Regarding the political realignment scenarios raised in political circles, Secretary Hong said, "The Blue House has never planned discussions on political realignment. The Democratic Party alone holds over 160 seats, a majority. There is absolutely no reason for political realignment." <<> Concerning Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho's expression of intent to resign, Secretary Hong remarked, "Most Blue House aides and cabinet members probably think about quitting. There are rumors that Minister Jeong is unwell, but he has not formally expressed his intent to resign." He added, "Prosecution reform is underway, and the Public Prosecution Service and the Anti-Corruption Bureau are set to launch in October. Shouldn't the minister in charge see these matters through and establish the system until it stabilizes?" <<> Regarding the Democratic Party's decision to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers as party policy, potentially as early as the 30th, Secretary Hong stated, "The Blue House's position was announced by Prime Minister Kim Min-seok in May. There has been no change in our stance that the party should decide based on the abolition of supplementary investigation powers." <<> Addressing allegations of a backroom deal to drop prosecution, Secretary Hong said, "Conspiracy theories about behind-the-scenes deals with the prosecution are baseless. There is no reason to engage in backroom deals with the prosecution, nor do we intend to." He added, "These are not issues to be resolved through backroom deals with the prosecution. No such deal has ever remained hidden forever." He concluded, "The President's consistent stance has been transparent communication with the public. There is not a shred of intention to clandestinely resolve issues through backroom deals with any power agency or vested interests." (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 29일 조정식 국회의장의 ‘대통령 연임 개헌’ 발언 논란에 대해 “현행 헌법에 현직 대통령의 연임을 포함한 개헌은 현실적으로 불가능하다”고 밝혔다. 홍 수석은 이날 MBC라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “(헌법에) 현직 대통령은 개헌 관련 사항에 귀속되지 않도록 해놨다”며 이같이 말했다.)

item.description:

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik: "President Lee also stated that a 're-election constitutional amendment' is impossible... I regret the political offensive" (강훈식 “李대통령도 ‘연임 개헌’ 불가 밝혀…정치 공세 유감”)
item.description:
Kang Hoon-sik: "President Lee also stated that a 're-election constitutional amendment' is impossible... I regret the political offensive" (강훈식 “李대통령도 ‘연임 개헌’ 불가 밝혀…정치 공세 유감”)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated on the 29th regarding the controversy over a 'presidential re-election constitutional amendment,' "Even though the President has said it is impossible, it is being used to drag the President into political debate, and I express very strong regret." <<> Chief Kang met with reporters at the Chunchugwan that morning and said regarding the re-election constitutional amendment controversy, "President Lee Jae-myung stated during his presidential candidate days that the constitutional system does not allow it, the public will not easily tolerate it, and it is realistically impossible." He added, "To add my personal thoughts, I believe Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution should remain unshaken in the future," emphasizing it as "a historical agreement we must uphold." Current Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution stipulates, "A constitutional amendment to extend the president's term or change the provision for re-election has no effect on the president in office at the time the amendment is proposed." <<> Previously, on the 28th, Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, during his first press conference after taking office, sparked controversy by answering a question about concerns from the opposition over a 'constitutional amendment for the incumbent president's term extension' by saying, "Ultimately, it is a matter of public opinion, which belongs to the sovereign people, and the people's choice." <<> Regarding the background of the constitutional amendment, Chief Kang said, "There are many pending issues, from including the full text of the May 18 spirit to recent issues with the National Election Commission." On the 're-election constitutional amendment' controversy, he stated, "Even though the National Assembly Speaker has explained again and the President has said it is impossible, it is being used to drag things into political debate, and I express very strong regret." He also said, "The presidential office and the President are focused on achieving results during the overseas trip, and real estate policies, stock prices, and the people's livelihood and economy are important matters. There is no time to waste on unnecessary and inappropriate discussions." (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 29일 ‘대통령 연임 개헌’ 관련 논란에 대해 “대통령이 불가하다고 하셨는데도 대통령을 정치적인 논쟁으로 끌어들이기 위해 사용하고 있어 매우 강한 유감”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Heonjeonghoe Chairman: "No force should pursue constitutional amendment for power extension... It is the solemn command of the people and democracy" (헌정회장 “어떤 세력도 정권 연장 개헌 안 돼…국민과 민주주의의 준엄한 명령”)
item.description:
Heonjeonghoe Chairman: "No force should pursue constitutional amendment for power extension... It is the solemn command of the people and democracy" (헌정회장 “어떤 세력도 정권 연장 개헌 안 돼…국민과 민주주의의 준엄한 명령”)

Jeong Dae-cheol, Chairman of the Korea Constitutional Association, stated on the 29th, "No political force should attempt to extend their rule through a constitutional amendment," asserting that discussions on constitutional revision should exclude the possibility of the incumbent president's re-election. (정대철 대한민국헌정회장은 29일 “어떤 정치 세력도 개헌을 통한 정권 연장을 시도해서는 안 된다”며 현직 대통령의 연임을 개헌 논의 대상에서 제외해야 한다고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, on the previous day, National Assembly Speaker Cho Jeong-sik said in his first press conference since taking office regarding a constitutional amendment for incumbent presidential re-election, "Ultimately, it is a matter of public opinion, the sovereign people, and their choice," adding, "It depends on how the various political stakeholders reach an agreement." This remark was interpreted as leaving room for applying a re-election system to President Lee Jae-myung if a national consensus is formed, sparking controversy in political circles. The People Power Party opposed it as a constitutional amendment theory aimed at extending President Lee's term, while the National Assembly Speaker's office clarified, "It was not intended to open the possibility of the incumbent president's re-election." <<> Chairman Jeong issued a statement on the same day, commending Speaker Cho's clarification that "the incumbent president's re-election is not a subject of constitutional amendment discussions," saying, "It is a natural stance in line with constitutional values and the spirit of parliamentary democracy," and adding, "I highly appreciate and welcome it." <<> Chairman Jeong emphasized that Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution explicitly states that a constitutional amendment for extending the president's term or changing term limits does not apply to the president in office at the time the amendment is proposed. He said, "This provision stems from historical lessons of power extension through constitutional amendments under past dictatorial regimes," and called it "a solemn command of the people and democracy that no political force can deny." <<> He continued, "With Speaker Cho's clarification, the controversy over the possibility of a constitutional amendment for incumbent presidential re-election is completely resolved," urging both ruling and opposition parties to begin discussions on a decentralized power structure constitutional amendment. <<> The Korea Constitutional Association holds that a constitutional amendment is necessary to disperse imperial presidential power and internal parliamentary power, including the introduction of a responsible prime minister system, a bicameral legislature, and strengthened local autonomy. It also stated that the amendment should include provisions for a popular initiative system and gender equality. <<> Chairman Jeong concluded, "The ruling and opposition parties should immediately form a special constitutional amendment committee in the National Assembly and complete a constitutional amendment for a decentralized power structure by the 2028 general election or before." (앞서 조정식 국회의장은 전날 취임 후 첫 기자간담회에서 현직 대통령의 연임 개헌에 대해 “결국 주권자인 국민 여론과 국민 선택의 문제”라며 “여러 정치적 당사자가 어떻게 합의하느냐에 달린 문제”라고 했다. 이 발언은 국민적 합의가 이뤄질 경우 이재명 대통령에게도 연임제를 적용할 가능성을 열어둔 것으로 해석되면서 정치권에서 논란이 됐다. 국민의힘은 이 대통령의 임기 연장을 위한 개헌론이라고 반발했고, 국회의장실은 “현직 대통령의 연임 가능성을 열어둔 취지가 아니다”라고 해명했다.)

item.title: Opposition Attacks Stock Market Crash: "The People Are Victims of Lee's 'Trading Room'" (野, 주가폭락 사태 맹공 “국민은 李 운영 리딩방 피해자”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) on the 29th criticized the domestic stock market's sharp decline, which triggered circuit breakers for two consecutive days, saying, "Is this a rollercoaster (roller-coaster + KOSPI)?" and "It's like pushing people's assets into a casino." (국민의힘이 29일 국내 증시가 급락하며 이틀 연속 서킷 브레이커가 발동된 데 대해 “롤러코스피냐” “국민 재산을 카지노판에 밀어 넣은 것”이라고 비판했다.)

PPP Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik posted on Facebook that afternoon, stating, "Before the Lee Jae-myung administration, was there ever a 'Rollercoaster KOSPI' where sidecars and circuit breakers ran rampant in our stock market?" He added, "The government should humbly accept responsibility for causing the stock market chaos and apologize to the people who have suffered huge losses from the stock price crash." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “이재명 정부 이전에 우리 증시에 이렇게 사이드카와 서킷브레이커가 난무하는 ‘롤러코스피’가 있었느냐”며 “주식시장 혼란을 초래한 정부 책임을 겸허히 수용하고 주가 폭락으로 큰 피해를 본 국민들께 사과하라”고 했다.)

He continued, "President Lee once said he would show that 'messing around in the stock market leads to ruin.' If so, the 'policy games' that have turned the stock market into such a chaotic casino gambling den should be the very things that lead to ruin." (그러면서 “이 대통령은 ‘주식시장에서 장난치다가는 패가망신한다’는 것을 보여주겠다고 했었다”며 “그렇다면 지금 주식시장을 이토록 어지러운 카지노 도박판으로 만든 ‘정책 장난’이야말로 패가망신시켜야 할 일”이라고 했다.)

He also demanded the dismissal of Kim Yong-beom, head of the Presidential Office’s Policy Planning Office. Floor Leader Jeong said, "As the economic control tower, Director Kim bears great responsibility for plunging the stock market and economy into chaos, yet he is still busy evading responsibility rather than reflecting. President Lee should immediately dismiss the incompetent and irresponsible Director Kim and completely overhaul the economic team." (그러면서 김용범 청와대 정책실장의 경질을 요구했다. 정 원내대표는 “김 실장은 경제 컨트롤 타워로서 주식시장과 경제를 혼란에 빠뜨린 책임이 큰데도 아직 반성보다는 책임 회피에 급급하다”며 “이 대통령은 무능하고 무책임한 김 실장을 즉각 경질하고, 경제 라인을 전면 교체하라”고 했다.)

Fellow PPP lawmaker Kim Eun-hye said, "Yesterday's KOSPI drop of -10.8% was larger than the -9.44% on October 16, 2008, during the Lehman Brothers crisis that triggered the global financial crisis." She added, "The vulnerability of the KOSPI, which recorded its fourth-largest drop in history, is due to the breakdown of market economy principles and procedures." (같은 당 김은혜 의원도 “어제 코스피의 –10.8% 낙폭은 글로벌 금융 위기를 부른 리먼 브러더스 사태 당시 2008년 10월 16일의 –9.44%보다도 컸다”며 “코스피가 역사상 네 번째 낙폭을 보인 취약성은 시장경제의 원칙과 절차가 무너졌기 때문”이라고 했다.)

She further stated, "Eventually, even the president's casual remark, 'I'll sell my house and buy ETFs,' went through the policy director, who is called a 'nickname on a stock forum,' and led to the release of highly volatile leveraged ETF products. It was like pouring oil on a blazing fire," adding, "The people's assets have been pushed into a casino." (그러면서 “급기야 대통령까지 ‘집 팔아 ETF 사겠다’ 한마디에 ‘종토방 고닉’ 소리 듣는 정책실장 거쳐 변동성이 큰 레버리지 ETF 상품이 투하됐다. 활활타는 장에 기름을 부은 것”이라며 “국민 재산을 카지노 판에 밀어 넣었다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop said, "President Lee Jae-myung has been running state affairs like an economic YouTuber." He added, "In the process, the people of South Korea are unknowingly becoming victims of the massive 'trading room' that President Lee Jae-myung operates." (김재섭 의원은 “이재명 대통령은 국정 운영을 경제 유튜버처럼 해왔다”며 “그러는 동안 대한민국 국민은 자신도 모르는 사이에 이재명 대통령이 운영하는 거대한 리딩방의 피해자가 되고 있다”고 했다.)

He also said, "He illegally intervened in the management of the National Pension Service, a retirement fund for the people, and turned the capital market into a huge speculative arena." He concluded, "President Lee, who once boasted of '8,000 KOSPI, 9,000 KOSPI,' has ultimately left behind nothing but ruining the two pillars supporting the people's livelihood—the stock market and the real estate market—with a 'one-shot, two-kills' approach." (그러면서 “국민의 노후 자금인 국민연금 운용에 위법하게 개입하며 자본시장을 거대한 투기판으로 변질시켰다”며 “‘8000피, 9000피’를 자랑하던 이재명 대통령이 남긴 것은 결국 국민의 삶을 떠받치는 양대 축인 주식 시장과 부동산 시장을 ‘1타 2피’로 망가뜨린 것뿐”이라고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Holds Meeting with Youth at Olympic Park: "If the Special Counsel Bill for the Elections Commission Fails to Pass, the Collapse of the Lee Jae-myung Regime Will Begin" (국힘, 올공 청년들과 간담회 “선관위 특검법 통과 안되면 李정권 몰락 시작될 것")
item.description:
On the 29th, the People Power Party held a meeting with youth who have been continuing a protest rally at Seoul's Songpa-gu Olympic Park condemning the infringement of voting rights, in connection with the shortage of ballots for the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘은 29일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 서울 송파구 올림픽공원(올공)에서 참정권 침해 규탄 집회를 이어가고 있는 청년들과 간담회를 열었다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk attended the "Olympic Park Youth Speak Out" meeting hosted by lawmaker Choi Soo-jin at the National Assembly, stating, "By August 2, it will be 60 days since the June 3 ballot shortage and voting rights infringement incident occurred. Despite this massive incident, the political circles have not even agreed on a special counsel bill as the 60-day mark approaches." He claimed that while the ruling and opposition parties had reached a broad agreement on the method of recommending a special counsel, the scope and targets of the investigation have yet to be finalized. Jang has been arguing that suspicions regarding the Election Commission's servers and computer manipulation should also be included in the special counsel's investigation. <<> Jang said, "Setting aside the special counsel bill, the Democratic Party is pushing to pass a criminal procedure law abolishing supplementary investigative powers at tomorrow's plenary session. If the special counsel bill does not pass tomorrow, it will mark the beginning of the collapse of the Lee Jae-myung regime." <<> Lawmaker Choi Hyung-doo remarked, "Since the Olympic Park polling station was the most contentious site where voting rights were infringed upon, if the youth directly supervise the analysis of ballots from seven electoral districts, it could yield significant results." <<> The meeting was also attended by youth volunteering at Olympic Park, youth continuing the protest rally in Incheon condemning voting rights infringement, and the Fairness and Responsibility Youth Alliance, which has been voicing criticism regarding the voting rights infringement incident. (장동혁 대표는 이날 최수진 의원이 국회에서 주최한 ‘올공 청년들은 말한다’ 간담회에 참석해 “8월 2일이 되면 6·3 투표용지 부족, 참정권 침해 사태가 발생한 지 60일이 된다. 이 엄청난 사태가 발생했는데 정치권은 60일이 다 돼가도록 아직 특검법조차 합의하지 못했다”고 했다. 여야는 앞서 특검 추천 방식 등 큰 틀에선 합의했으나, 수사 대상과 범위 등은 아직 확정되지 않았다는 주장이다. 장 대표는 선관위 서버와 전산 조작 의혹 등도 특검 수사 대상에 포함해야 한다고 주장해왔다.)

item.title: "Scrap Samjeon-Nik's Leverage" Procession of Funeral Wreaths Before the National Assembly (“삼전닉스 레버리지 폐기하라” 국회 앞 근조화환 행렬)
item.description:
Amid growing controversy over losses suffered by individual investors due to the crash of single-stock leveraged ETFs for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, about 30 funeral wreaths demanding the abolition of these products were delivered en masse and lined up in front of the National Assembly building in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 29th. (삼성전자·SK하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 ETF 폭락으로 개인투자자 피해 논란이 커지는 가운데, 29일 서울 여의도 국회의사당 앞에 이 상품의 폐지를 요구하는 근조화환 30여 개가 대량 배달돼 줄지어 놓였다.)

The wreaths, sent by the individual investor group "Meeting for the Normalization of the Stock Market," bore slogans such as "Investor protection is just lip service?" and "Delist them." The wreaths stretched along the sidewalk in front of the Assembly, with passersby stopping to read the messages or take photos. The group called for the products to be abolished, claiming that single-stock leveraged ETFs amplify the volatility of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix stocks, exacerbating damage to individual investors. (개인투자자 단체인 ‘주식시장정상화를위한모임’이 보낸 화환에는 ‘투자자 보호 말로만?’ ‘상장 폐지하라’ 등의 문구가 적혔다. 화환은 국회 앞 인도를 따라 길게 늘어섰고, 시민들이 발걸음을 멈추고 문구를 살펴보거나 사진을 찍기도 했다. 이 단체는 단일종목 레버리지 ETF가 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 주가 변동성을 증폭시키고 개인투자자 피해를 키웠다며 상품 폐지를 요구했다.)

Single-stock leveraged ETFs are high-risk products that aim to deliver double the daily return of the underlying stock. On the previous day, as the KOSPI plunged by over 8% triggering a circuit breaker, leveraged products linked to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix also crashed by around 25%. When the price of the underlying stock falls, losses double, and if the stock price fluctuates repeatedly, the principal can shrink due to the "negative compounding effect." (단일종목 레버리지 ETF는 기초 종목의 하루 수익률을 두 배로 추종하는 고위험 상품이다. 전날 코스피가 8%대 급락하며 서킷브레이커가 발동한 가운데 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 관련 레버리지 상품도 25% 안팎 폭락했다. 기초 종목의 주가가 하락하면 손실이 두 배로 커지고, 주가가 등락을 반복하면 ‘음의 복리 효과’로 원금이 줄어들 수 있다.)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the Presidential Policy Office, who is known to have led the introduction of these products, takes the stance that they should not bear all the blame. While accompanying President Lee Jae-myung on a visit to Brazil, Kim stated at the Sao Paulo Press Center on the 28th (local time), "The leveraged ETF might make volatility more pronounced, but it's not entirely accurate to attribute many issues solely to that product." He added, "The Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service are planning to review not just the leveraged ETFs but overall structural factors." (상품 도입을 주도한 것으로 알려진 김용범 대통령정책실장은 단일종목 레버리지 ETF에 모든 책임을 돌려서는 안 된다는 입장이다. 이재명 대통령의 브라질 방문을 수행 중인 김 실장은 28일(현지 시각_ 상파울루 프레스센터에서 “레버리지 ETF로 변동성이 더욱 도드라져 보일 수는 있지만, 상당히 많은 문제가 다 그것 하나로 귀결되는 것처럼 말하는 것은 꼭 그렇지 않다”고 했다. 그러면서 “레버리지 ETF뿐 아니라 전반적인 구조적 요인을 금융위원회와 금융감독원이 점검해보려고 한다”고 했다.)

Kim Yong-beom cited market uncertainty over whether AI investments will translate into actual profits and the pursuit of Chinese semiconductor companies as backgrounds to the recent stock market crash. He also noted that the active trading of individual investors, the high proportion of derivatives, and the significant weight of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in the domestic stock market combine to amplify external shocks. (김용범 실장은 최근 증시 급락의 배경으로 인공지능 투자가 실제 수익으로 이어질지에 대한 시장의 불확실성과 중국 반도체 업체의 추격 등을 들었다. 또 개인투자자의 활발한 거래와 파생상품 비중, 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 국내 증시에서 차지하는 높은 비중이 맞물려 외부 충격이 증폭되는 측면이 있다고 했다.)

Financial authorities have decided to consider raising the investment threshold. Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won, during a report to the National Assembly's Political Affairs Committee on the same day, responded to a request for additional measures from Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Hyun-jung by saying, "If necessary, we will consider various methods, such as further increasing the initial deposit requirement." (금융당국은 투자 문턱을 더 높이는 방안을 검토하기로 했다. 이억원 금융위원장은 이날 국회 정무위원회 업무보고에서 김현정 민주당 의원이 추가 대책을 요구하자 “필요하다면 기본예탁금을 추가로 올리는 등 다양한 방법을 고민하겠다”고 했다.)

Starting from the 31st, the Financial Services Commission plans to require individual investors looking to newly buy or add to positions in single-stock leveraged products to have an initial deposit of at least 30 million won in cash. Chairman Lee said the industry expects this measure to reduce trading accounts from about 100,000 to 10,000 and cut trading volume by approximately 60%. Regarding a plan to lower the current 2x leverage ratio, he stated, "It could be effective in terms of mitigating volatility," and added that options such as allowing only professional investors to make new purchases or placing per-investor limits could also be considered. (금융위는 31일부터 단일종목 레버리지 상품을 신규 또는 추가 매수하려는 개인투자자에게 현금 3000만원 이상의 기본예탁금을 요구할 예정이다. 이 위원장은 이 조치가 시행되면 거래 계좌가 약 10만 개에서 1만 개 수준으로 줄고, 거래량도 약 60% 감소할 것으로 업계가 예상한다고 했다. 현행 두 배인 레버리지 배율을 낮추는 방안에 대해서도 “변동성 완화 측면에서는 효과가 있을 것”이라며 전문투자자만 신규 매수를 허용하거나 투자자별 한도를 두는 방안도 검토할 수 있다고 했다.)

Criticism also emerged from within the Democratic Party that the product design was inappropriate. Lawmaker Oh Ki-hyung, chairman of the party's K-Capital Market Special Committee, said on the 27th, "It's an 'all-in risk product' that ignores the diversification characteristic of ETFs," adding, "Attaching the term 'ETF' to a high-risk derivative financial product is inappropriate." He continued, "There is awareness of the issue of whether such product design was appropriate," and noted, "Because it's a factor in market disruption, restraint is necessary." (민주당 내부에서도 상품 설계가 부적절했다는 비판이 나왔다. 당 K-자본시장특별위원장인 오기형 의원은 지난 27일 “ETF가 가진 분산투자 특성을 몰각한 ‘몰빵 위험 상품’”이라며 “고위험 파생금융상품에 ETF라는 단어를 붙이는 것은 부적절하다”고 했다. 이어 “이런 상품 설계가 적당했느냐는 문제의식이 있다”며 “시장 교란 요인 중 하나이기 때문에 절제가 필요하다”고 했다.)

However, caution was also voiced regarding immediate delisting. Lawmaker Kim Nam-geun, secretary of the special committee, said, "Hastily discussing delisting right now could undermine trust in the stock market. We will likely move in a direction that reduces product appeal and curtails volatility." (다만 즉각적인 상장폐지에는 신중론도 나왔다. 특위 간사인 김남근 의원은 “당장 급하게 상장폐지를 논의하는 것은 주식시장의 신뢰를 떨어뜨리는 문제”라며 “상품성을 떨어뜨리고 변동성을 줄이는 방향으로 가게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Lee Kang-il stated, "Small investors who invest 5 to 10 million won tend to show higher risk tolerance," and opined, "If we raise the deposit requirement to put a brake on the inflow of speculative funds, the market will become more rational." Lawmaker Min Byung-deok added that if market instability persists, "We could consider raising the deposit requirement to 50 million won." <<>> (이강일 의원은 “500만~1000만원을 투자하는 소액 투자자일수록 고위험 성향을 보인다”며 “예탁금을 높여 투기성 자금 유입에 브레이크를 걸면 시장이 한층 이성적으로 변할 것”이라고 했다. 민병덕 의원은 시장 불안이 계속될 경우 “예탁금을 5000만원으로 늘리는 방안도 고려할 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Revived ‘Dismissal of Indictment’... Ruling Party Slipped It In Late at Night (다시 살아난 ‘공소기각’... 與 한밤 끼워넣었다 )
item.description:
It was confirmed on the 29th that the Criminal Procedure Act amendment pushed by the Democratic Party of Korea includes a clause adding grounds for the 'dismissal of an indictment' by the prosecution. (더불어민주당이 추진하는 형사소송법 개정안에 공소청 검사의 ‘공소기각’ 사유를 추가한 조항이 담긴 것으로 29일 확인됐다.)

Following the Democratic Party's complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers, it has now attached conditions under which the prosecution’s authority to request a trial—the indictment—can also be dismissed. (민주당이 검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지한 데 이어, 검사가 재판을 청구하는 권한인 공소(公訴)까지 기각할 수 있는 조건을 달아놓은 것이다.)

The previous day, the subcommittee of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee passed this revised Criminal Procedure Act late at night. Article 327 of the Criminal Procedure Act has been supplemented with grounds such as 'when an indictment is filed based on serious illegal investigations' and 'when an indictment is filed with a significant deviation from prosecutorial discretion.' (전날 국회 법제사법위원회 소위는 이러한 내용이 담긴 형사소송법을 늦은 밤 통과시켰다. 형사소송법 제327조에는 ‘중대한 위법수사에 기해 공소가 제기됐을 때’ ‘소추재량권을 현저히 일탈해 공소가 제기됐을 때’ 등의 사유가 추가됐다.)

However, there are also criticisms that the conditions for dismissing an indictment are ambiguous. It is unclear how terms like 'serious' and 'significant' will be applied in actual cases. (하지만 공소를 기각할 수 있는 조건이 애매모호하다는 지적도 나온다. ‘중대한’ ‘현저히’라는 용어가 실제 사건에 어떻게 적용될지 모른다는 것이다.)

In response, the opposition party has begun criticizing this in connection with the cancellation of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon wrote on his Facebook page, "Since there is no possibility of an acquittal in Lee Jae-myung's North Korea remittance bribery case, and canceling the indictment is not feasible, it seems the Democratic Party is unilaterally creating a new law for dismissing indictments to pressure the court, forcing it to issue a ruling of dismissal tailored to this case." (이에 야당은 이재명 대통령 공소취소와 연관 지어 비판하고 나섰다. 한동훈 무소속 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “이재명 대북 송금 뇌물 사건 무죄 가능성이 없고, 공소 취소는 여의치 않으니, 민주당 단독으로 새로 공소기각법 만들어서 법원 압박해서 억지로 여기 끼워 맞춰 공소 기각 판결 받아보자는 것”이라고 했다.)

He added, "To avoid prison after President Lee’s term, canceling the indictment is Plan A, constitutional revision for dictatorship and extended term is Plan B, and dismissing the indictment is Plan C." (그러면서 “이 대통령 임기 후 감옥 안 가기 위해, 공소 취소가 플랜 A, 독재명 연임 개헌이 플랜 B, 공소 기각이 플랜 C”라고도 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo also said on Facebook, "There is no standard for what constitutes a 'serious' illegal act or how much deviation is 'significant,'" and called "the Democratic Party's revision to the Criminal Procedure Act the 'President Lee Jae-myung Indictment Cancellation Act.'" (국민의힘 주진우 의원도 페이스북에서 “무엇이 ‘중대한’ 위법이고, 어느 정도가 ‘현저한’ 일탈인지 기준도 없다”며 “민주당의 형소법 개정안은 ‘이재명 대통령 공소 취소법’”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "Now that it seems difficult to get a special counsel for canceling the indictment, they’re creating a bypass for the court to dismiss the indictment," and "This is an attempt to use legislative power to erase a president's personal criminal trial. Withdraw the bill immediately." (이어 “공소 취소 특검이 어려워진다 싶으니까 이번에는 법원이 공소를 기각하도록 우회로를 만든 것”이라며 “입법권으로 대통령 개인의 형사재판을 지우려는 시도다. 당장 법안을 철회하라”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the Legislation and Judiciary Committee referred the Criminal Procedure Act to the Agenda Coordination Committee for review on Thursday at the request of the People Power Party. The Agenda Coordination Committee is a body that allows for deliberation of contentious bills for up to 90 days. (한편, 이날 법사위는 국민의힘 요구로 형사소송법을 안건조정위에 회부해 심사 중이다. 안건조정위는 이견이 있는 법안을 처리할 때 최장 90일간 법안을 숙의할 수 있도록 한 회의체다.)
